packageRules.description: Exempt update types that carry no release timestamp from the minimum release-age bake, so their renovate/stability-days check can resolve under internalChecksFilter:strict

Poetry resolves the newest release in range rather than the version Renovate targeted, so an in-range update writes a lockfile Renovate then rejects. :pinDevDependencies does not reach this group: it matches the devDependencies, dev-dependencies, and dev depTypes, and a Poetry group's depType is its name

customManagers.description: Read `# renovate:` annotations above *_VERSION pins in dev container setup scripts
